weekend.term: Fall 2026: eight weeks to October 31, then a three-Saturday mini-semester November 7 to 21
weekend.look: Classes are grouped by grade band under the eight-week and mini-semester headings, each with a “Saturdays” line and its own registration link.

weekend.term: Fall 2026: Saturday classes run September 19 to November 21
weekend.look: Dates sit in the intro text. The Saturday class grid is an embedded schedule and a “Fall listings” link to the registration system.
weekend.notes: The page address has the term in it, so the next term is a new page.

weekend.term: 2026–27: fall runs August 31 to December 20, and winter and spring January 4 to June 13
weekend.look: Each instrument section lists its levels as lines like “Level, SATURDAYS at a time (age)”.
Each studio’s weekly schedule has a Saturday row listing times and class names.

weekend.term: Spring 2027: to June 4, starting January 31 for grades 1–4 and January 10 for grades 5–8
weekend.look: Classes are listed under day-of-week headings, which are images, each line giving class, grades, time and price. Repeat for the grades 5–8 page.
weekend.notes: The day headings are images, so a plain text read loses them; the fetch tool reads them.

weekend.look: Days and times are in the Saturday column of the two linked school-aged schedule PDFs (Bok and Queen Village). Prices are in the weekend tuition table on the page.
weekend.notes: The PDF grids read poorly: some Saturday slots come back without class names.

weekend.term: Fall 2026: October 10 to December 19, with no class November 28
weekend.look: Each class card shows the title with its age range, then the day, the time, the date range and the price.
weekend.notes: The category address changes with the term (classes-for-kids4). The site’s home page loads by script and comes back empty.

list.name: Philadelphia Rock Gym summer camps
list.look: The Summer Camps section has a block per camp with ages, prices and hours. Gym addresses are on each location’s own page.
list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07. The site could not be read by the fetch tool the same day.
list.signup: The page said registration is coming soon.

list.name: Allens Lane Art Center summer art camp
list.look: Dates are at the top under “About Summer Camp”. Prices, discounts and before and after care are in the “Fees & Discounts” section.
list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07; a plain fetch was not tried, so it may also work.
list.signup: Sign-ups for 2026 started January 26 at 8 am.

list.name: Arden Drama School
list.look: Dates, hours and prices sit in the kids summer camp brochure, a PDF linked from the summer section of the Arden Drama School page.
list.notes: The page itself comes back with no camp details through a plain fetch, and the brochure’s address changes each year.

list.name: Awbury Adventures at Awbury Arboretum
list.look: A session list grouped by age band gives each session’s dates and price. Hours, after-camp and financial aid are in the text around it.
list.notes: The page is mid-changeover: the header says 2027 while the session list and prices are still 2026.
list.signup: Registration for summer 2027 opens February 1, 2027 at 9 am, and a week earlier for family members. The page gives the 2027 season as June 14 to August 20.

list.name: Butcher’s Sew Shop Junior
list.look: The Jumbula summer-camp page lists each themed week as a row with dates, age group and price, with hours, extended care and discounts in the page text.
list.notes: Details live on the shop’s Jumbula registration site.

list.name: Camp TPS at The Philadelphia School
list.look: Season dates are in the intro of the Camp TPS page. The price range and daily hours are on the linked Rates & Info page, and per-camp weeks are in the linked catalog.

list.name: Camp Walnut at Walnut Street Theatre
list.look: Each division is a separate course card in the CourseStorm catalog. Dates, hours and price are on the individual course page.
list.notes: The category address has the year in it. Listing pages load by script and come back empty; individual course pages fetch fine.

list.name: C.E.O. Camp at Phield House
list.look: The week list, weekly price and before and after care terms are in the body text of the Phield House summer camp page.
list.notes: ceocampspa.com is the same camp but returns only a title to a plain fetch.

list.name: Philadelphia School of Circus Arts
list.look: Price, hours, age groups and care fees are in the camp page text. The week dates sit behind the enrollment link.

list.name: The Clay Studio
list.look: Dates, hours and add-on fees are in the camp policies page. Camp weeks and tuition sit in the booking listing at public.theclaystudio.org/public/3/camps, which needs a browser.
list.signup: The 2026 early-bird discount ran January 2 to February 15.

list.name: CoCo Academy
list.look: The top paragraph gives ages, the first and last week and the daily hours. Prices, early drop-off, extended day and the July 4 week are under “Pricing” in the Camp Info section lower down.
list.notes: The site does not allow automated reading and the browser extension is not allowed on it, so Josh pastes the page text (last pasted 2026-10-07). Registration runs through Sawyer, one link per location.
list.signup: Online. Its camp page has a separate Register button for Bella Vista and for Queen Village, and early drop-off and extended day are add-ons at checkout.

list.name: The Dandelion Project summer camp
list.look: Price and sliding scale are in the intro. Each of the three camp types has its own block of dates.
list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07; a plain fetch was not tried, so it may also work. The site answered 429 to a plain fetch earlier the same day. The old address /summercamp is gone.

list.name: Fleisher Art Memorial
list.look: Session dates are listed week by week and prices appear as member and non-member rates per age group in the page body.
list.notes: The street address is not on the camp page; it is Fleisher’s own building.

list.name: FlipOut Productions
list.look: The Summer Camp page shows age groups and activities. Weeks and prices are probably inside an embedded registration widget.

list.name: Camp Tech Revolution at UPenn (Lavner)
list.look: The location page describes the camp and its address. Weeks and prices are in the enrollment system behind “Enroll Now”.
list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07; a plain fetch was not tried, so it may also work.

list.name: Legacy Youth Tennis community camp
list.look: Dates, hours, ages and the flat seven-week price are in the body text of the full-day camp page.
list.notes: The price is one fee for the whole summer, not weekly. The page prints dates without a year.
list.signup: The page says registration opens January 5.

list.name: MacGuffin Theatre & Film Company
list.look: The camps page lists each camp with ages and dates and links to per-camp pages with hours. Tuition appears only in the Sawyer booking widget.
list.signup: Sign-ups for the 2026 camps began December 1, 2025.

list.name: Mister John’s Music
list.look: Weeks and themes are a dated list in the page body, with the weekly price and the early and late fees in the text beside it.
list.notes: The Register buttons come back with empty links through a plain fetch.

list.name: Moore College of Art & Design youth courses
list.look: Dates, the daily schedule and the price per course are in the Program Details text.
list.notes: The camp page has the year in its address, so next summer is a new page. Start from the youth-education page to find it.

list.name: Nature Explorers at Morris Arboretum & Gardens
list.look: Session dates, member and non-member prices, hours and age groups are all in the body text of the summer camp page.

list.name: MoveMakers Philly
list.look: Weeks are on the overview page. Hours, price and discounts are in the text of each camp’s own subpage, which links to Mindbody for booking.
list.notes: Three camp subpages with the year in their titles, so the addresses may change for 2027.

list.name: Music Theatre Philly
list.look: A week-by-week list gives dates, theme, grades and price, each with its own Sawyer register link.
list.notes: Hours, care fees and discounts sit on /about-camps and the Pre-K weeks on /summer-camps-pre-k.

list.name: NLArts summer art camp
list.look: Fees by grade group are in the “Information & Fees” section. Session dates are inside the headings under “Sessions & Themes”, which open on a click.
list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07; a plain fetch was not tried, so it may also work. The old address /summer-art-camp-program is now a menu of programs.

list.name: PAFA summer art camp
list.look: Dates, hours, price and discounts are in the body of the family-programs summer art camp page. Sign-up is on CourseStorm.
list.notes: pafa.org/camp is a stale page still showing summer 2024. Use the family-programs address.

list.name: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation day camps
list.look: The service page gives ages, fee waivers and the steps for finding a rec center. Dates were only in a news post, and fees and hours are set per center.
list.notes: The dated post was first published in 2024 and its dates may be stale; do not copy them.

list.name: School of Philadelphia Ballet dance camps
list.look: Camp themes, dates, the daily schedule and tuition sit in the Summer Dance Camps section, with a registration link per camp.
list.notes: Separate pages exist for the New Jersey and Bala Cynwyd locations; use the Philadelphia page only.

list.name: The Philadelphia Dance Academy
list.look: The Summer Dance Programs page lists programs and ages only. Dates and weekly tuition are probably in the registration portal.
list.notes: An older, undated page at /programs/summer-program2/ has prices that look like 2023. Do not use it.
list.signup: The page says summer enrollment opens December 1.

list.name: Philly Art Center
list.look: The “By-the-week” date line is near the top and prices are in the “Weekly Rates” list on the same page. Sign-up buttons go to Captyn.
list.notes: There is a fourth location in Cherry Hill, NJ, which is left out. Tween camps run on select weeks only.

list.name: Queen & Rook Game Cafe
list.look: Hours, price, aftercare and discounts are in the product description. The week dates are in the product’s option picker, which a plain fetch does not return.
list.notes: The camp is sold on a separate store site, not the cafe’s own.

list.name: Rutabaga NatureArts summer camp
list.look: Ages, dates and schedule are under “Basics”, then “Pricing” and “Discounts”.
list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07; a plain fetch was not tried, so it may also work. The site answered 429 to a plain fetch earlier the same day.
list.signup: The page says 2027 summer camp information is coming soon. For 2026 the early-bird discount ran through February 28.

list.name: Sawubona Creativity Project

list.notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-07; a plain fetch was not tried, so it may also work.

list.name: School of Rock Philadelphia
list.look: The listing page gives camp names and dates. Each camp’s own page holds hours, ages and price.
list.notes: The listing page can still return last year’s line-up with no prices; open a dated camp page for the price.

list.name: Seaport Summer Camp at Independence Seaport Museum
list.look: Weeks and themes are listed on the camp page with a registration link per week. Prices sit in a pricing section on the same page.

list.name: Skate The Foundry skateboard camp

list.name: Summer Achievers at Extended Day, Extended Year schools

list.name: Taller Puertorriqueño

list.name: Theatre Horizon drama camp at Woodmere
list.look: A week-by-week table lists “Woodmere Art Museum, Chestnut Hill”. Each site’s price and sign-up link sit in a pop-up opened by its button.

list.name: Wissahickon Skating Club figure skating camp

list.name: Work to Ride at Chamounix Equestrian Center

list.name: Greater Philadelphia YMCA day camps
